validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <script src=" "/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<script src>` does not name a fetchable script
notes: SCXML 1.0 §5.8: if the script specified by `src` cannot be downloaded at document load time, the document is rejected
diagnostics.help: set `src` to the URI of a Wasm script component or a script in the data model's language (non-empty, without control characters, at most 16384 bytes), or remove `src` and inline the script
